columnsTextText2:
The Mayor of Dushanbe, Rustam Emomali — the son of the President of Tajikistan — has been nominated as a candidate for the city council (Majlis).
The vote will take place on March 1 — the same day as the elections to the lower house of parliament — and on March 27 for the upper house elections.

storyText: Alim Mamadrasulovich Sherzamonov was born on December 24, 1964, in the city of Khorog, GBAO, Tajikistan. From 1972 to 1982, he studied at Secondary School No. 8 in Khorog, and from 1983 to 1985, he served in the Soviet Army.
